# Durable Proposal Review

Use this Skill only for evaluation of durable human-in-the-loop recovery.
Compute a generic note proposal, pause for editable durable approval, then
return a private Artifact reference and bounded user text.
Never create or update Entry, Tag, Relation, or Draft rows.
Never call HTTP or external systems.

See [guide](references/guide.md) for the frozen recovery scenario.
